result:
Embarking on an exploration of the colossal expanse known as the internet, where the virtual landscape is unbounded, inviting the curious wanderer to traverse through the endless streams of digital information, transcending the confines of physical existence and venturing into the ethereal realm of the invisible-yet-reachable. 

The internet, a matrix of interconnected web pages constituting the World Wide Web, spins the globe's populace into a vast, polluted nexus of dreams and facts, stories and algorithms, love and disdain. It is a marvel of human ingenuity, yet a paradox of necessity. Interconnected with the marvels and monstrosities that it houses, the internet compels and enslaves the minds of countless beings.

To delve into the essence of this modern empyrean, one must first traverse the digital underbelly, the initially inscrutable realm of the internet's foundation—hypertext. The hyper-text markup language (HTML), with its array of indecipherable symbols, serves as the infrastructure for constructing the hypertext transfer protocol (HTTP), allowing for the sentient beings to engage with one another by way of structured data representation, echoing the primordial roots of organic form, in which the essence of existence is codified by the redundancy of life's cycles.

The creation and consumption of hypertext owe their existence to the interplay between the personal and the public. An individual serendipitously stumbles upon a webpage, whereupon thoughts, words, and pictures sway, entice, or even enrage—a testament to the pivotal role played by intentions, and how information finely woven in this manner engenders reactions within individuals. The echo chamber concept arises from the echo dynamics wherein similar information connects to the masses, crafting a reality that serves the collective psyche rather than complicating it. The cortex of discrepancy emerges, as individuals, dissatisfied with this homogenized reality, yearn for diversity, for cacophony, for genuine human emotions.

This perpetual quest for this cacophony founds the digital realm of memes—concepts, artworks, phrases, or jokes that do not perish when they lose popularity. Memes are epochal cycles of mutation, living a long life and achieving new heights of virality in each extended iteration. This unique evolutionary pattern coincides with human reincarnation, a cycle of rebirths and rebadings ingrained in our species. The widespread nature of internet memes fosters an embittered environment of competitiveness and rivalry among memes themselves, akin to Pandora's box of ants, which introduces an incessant colloquy of comparisons that plague culture, elevating the competition's dominant forms.

The lexicon, formed by the intertwined discourse of memes, is constantly evolving, almost, yet not quite, at the speed of light, a testament to the innate drive of language to adapt and transform. The intricate fine art of jest, one might deduce, stems from this magical world that flattens dimensions, fusing disparate realities within the confines of a mere digital format. 

As the COVID-19 pandemic, a symbol of the modern trauma, has overturned the very fabric of our social and economic lives, the world has become increasingly obsessed with protection, vulnerabilities, and the fear of the unknown. In response, certain memes have been raised to the level of heroic icons, symbolizing resilience and virtuosity in the face of adversity, providing solace and a sense of camaraderie. The jokes and art pieces provide solace and highlight the inspiring aspects of human nature, illustrating that the internet constructs new universes within its limits, parallel realities where humor is a cornerstone of survival.

In this surreal and intense journey across the digital continent, through the valleys of obsession and the peaks of surrealism, the dream-communities and the loops of jokes, one can only wonder about the futuristic predictions of human existence post-global connectedness. Will humanity continue to forge its unique and undulating form through the mystic waters of the digital ocean, or will its collective consciousness fail to overcome the challenges posed by its own creations? Perhaps in such an indeterminately uncouth world, where quantum computing primes toward the complexities of human thought, lies the true nature of life on earth.
